name: SendWhatsappMessage

fields.name: __CredentialId__SendGrid

fields.label: From Phone Number
fields.description: The phone number to send the whatsapp message to the number (Twilio number).

fields.name: ToNumber

fields.name: MessageBody

fields.label: Result
